remarks:
This 107.7 acre property consists of open fields, woodlands, and beautiful valley views to build your dream home, cabin, or start your own farm located in Angelica NY, Allegany County.

A rare opportunity to own diverse and scenic acreage offering a perfect blend of open fields, hardwoods, wildlife habitat, and breathtaking valley views.  Several acres of productive hay and tillable ground stretch across the rolling landscape, much of which is already fenced and suitable for cattle or agricultural use.

The property features a mix of brushy bedding areas, hardwood timber, and established trails making it ideal for outdoor recreation.  Multiple food plots are already in place, and the property shows an abundance of whitetail deer sign creating a prime setup for the serious hunter.  An existing elevated hunting blind is positioned to overlook the fields and travel corridors.  A runoff stream winds through part of the wooded area adding natural character and supporting wildlife movement through the property.  The terrain and layout also provide excellent conditions for rifle hunting and long-range target shooting.

Whether you're looking to build your dream home, establish a hobby farm, create a private hunting retreat, or simply enjoy ATV riding and outdoor recreation, this property offers endless possibilities for the entire family.

A new survey has been completed, with surface rights conveying and 49% of the oil, gas, and mineral rights transferring with the sale.

Located just minutes from Palmers Pond State Forest and Palmers Pond where you can enjoy canoeing, kayaking, fishing, and thousands of acres of additional recreational land.  The historic Village of Angelica is only a short drive away for shopping, dining, and everyday conveniences.

This exceptional property combines agriculture, recreation, hunting, and incredible views, a rare find in today’s market.
